title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Week Numbers in date picker (Show or hide week numbers in calendar)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) adds the ability to show or hide week numbers in the calendar date picker using the Shift+Home keyboard shortcut, improving user experience when selecting dates in fields with calendar icons.
key_points: New feature allows toggling week numbers on or off in the calendar date picker
Activated using Shift+Home keyboard shortcut while the calendar is displayed
Available only in BC27, not in BC26.5 or earlier versions
Part of user experience improvements in the 2025 release wave 2

quotes.text: With this wave (BC27), We can use Shift + Home keyboard shortcut to show or hide week numbers in calendar.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the exact keyboard shortcut needed to toggle the new week numbers feature in the date picker
